verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of GitLab's merge request approval rules, protected branches, or deployment/environment approval gates that would enforce sign-off before production releases; only tangential material on security scanning in MRs and general CI/CD/build docs is present. Missing for 10: explicit docs on merge request approval rules, protected environments/deployment approvals, and any corroborating evidence of enforced pre-production gating.
